segments.name: North America Confectionery
segments.description: Chocolate and non-chocolate confectionery, gum and refreshment products, protein bars, spreads, pantry items and retail operations in the United States and Canada.
segments.evidence: This segment is responsible for our traditional chocolate and non-chocolate confectionery market position in the United States and Canada.

segments.name: North America Salty Snacks
segments.description: Salty snacking products in the United States, including ready-to-eat popcorn, baked snacks and pretzels.
segments.evidence: This segment is responsible for our salty snacking products in the United States.

segments.name: International
segments.description: Operations outside North America, manufacturing and selling confectionery and snack products in Mexico, Brazil, India, Malaysia and export markets.
segments.evidence: International is a combination of all other operating segments that are not individually material, including those geographic regions where we operate outside of North America.

revenueModel.text: Hershey is paid mainly by wholesale distributors, grocery stores, mass merchandisers, drug stores, clubs, convenience and dollar stores that resell its products to end-consumers.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers are mainly wholesale distributors, chain grocery stores, mass merchandisers, chain drug stores, vending companies, wholesale clubs, convenience stores, dollar stores, concessionaires, and department stores.

changes.text: In 2025, Hershey acquired LesserEvil, adding organic popcorn and puffed snack products to its portfolio.
changes.evidence: On November 18, 2025, we completed the acquisition of LesserEvil, LLC ("LesserEvil"), previously a privately held company that produces and sells organic popcorn and puffed snack products to retailers and distributors in the United States and Canada.

changes.text: In 2024, Hershey acquired the Sour Strips sour candy brand.
changes.evidence: On November 8, 2024, we completed the acquisition of the Sour Strips brand from Actual Candy, LLC.

changes.text: In 2023, Hershey acquired manufacturing assets from Weaver Popcorn Manufacturing, adding popcorn manufacturing capacity.
changes.evidence: On May 31, 2023, we completed the acquisition of certain assets that provide additional manufacturing capacity from Weaver Popcorn Manufacturing, Inc. ("Weaver"), a leader in the production and co-packing of microwave popcorn and ready-to-eat popcorn, and former co-manufacturer of the Company's SkinnyPop brand.
